findings.summary: Cancel editing leaves the program detail view and returns to the unfiltered curriculum list.
findings.fix: When editing a curriculum entry, include the selected program_id and curriculum_program_id in the Cancel editing URL so it returns to the originating program detail.
findings.evidence: The edit URL preserves both program IDs (line 592), but the Cancel editing URL includes only section and academic_view.

passed: Source review: detail actions use native links, buttons, and forms; curriculum table scrollers are keyboard-focusable and have visible focus styling.
notes: Runtime keyboard testing was blocked: the local admin route returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
